spans.s: स्थुड् vt. 1P (pres. स्थुडति) To cover.
स्थुल n. A sort of long tent.

स्थूल (I) a. (f. ला) (compar. स्थवीयस्; super. स्थविष्ठ) 1. Strong, powerful; 2. stout, bulky, big, huge, दिङ्नागानां पथि परिहरन् स्थूलहस्तावलेपान् Megh.i.14; 3. fat, corpulent; 4. thick, great, large, मुक्तास्थूलास्तरुकिसलयेष्वश्रुलेशाः पतंति Megh.ii.43; 5. not exact; 6. stolid, thick-headed; 7. stupid, dull, ignorant; 8. clumsy, coarse, rough, gross.
स्थूल (II) m. The jack tree.
स्थूल (III) n. 1. A heap, a quantity; 2. a tent; 3. the top or summit of a mountain.

स्थूल (I) a. (f. ला) (compar. स्थवीयस्; super. स्थविष्ठ) 1. Strong, powerful; 2. stout, bulky, big, huge, दिङ्नागानां पथि परिहरन् स्थूलहस्तावलेपान् Megh.i.14; 3. fat, corpulent; 4. thick, great, large, मुक्तास्थूलास्तरुकिसलयेष्वश्रुलेशाः पतंति Megh.ii.43; 5. not exact; 6. stolid, thick-headed; 7. stupid, dull, ignorant; 8. clumsy, coarse, rough, gross.
स्थूणा f. 1. The post or pillar of a house; 2. any post or pillar, यथेंद्रार्था स्थूणां इंद्रः K.Pr.ii.; 3. an iron image, a statue; 4. an anvil.
स्थूम m. 1. Light; 2. the moon.
स्थूर m. 1. A man; 2. a bull.
स्थूल् m. (denom. pres. स्थूलयति-ते) To become big or stout, to become bulky, to grow fat.
स्थूल-अंत्र n. the larger intestine near the anus.
स्थूल-आस्य m. a snake.

स्थूल-उच्चय m. 1. a large fragment of rock fallen, from a mountain and forming an irregular mound; 2. incompleteness, deficiency, defect; 3. the middle pace of elephants; 4. an eruption of pimples on the face; 5. a hollow at the root of an elephant’s tusks.
स्थूल-काय a. corpulent.
स्थूल-क्षेड, -क्ष्वेड m. an arrow.
स्थूल-क्षेड, -क्ष्वेड m. an arrow.
स्थूल-चाप m. large bow-like instrument used in cleaning cotton.
स्थूल-ता f. 1. bigness, bulkiness; 2. dullness, stupidity.
स्थूल-त्व n. 1. bigness, bulkiness; 2. dullness, stupidity.
स्थूल-नाल m. a kind of large reed.
स्थूल-नास, -नासिक (I) a. thick-nosed.
स्थूल-नास, -नासिक (I) a. thick-nosed.
स्थूल-नासिक (II) m. a hog, a boar.
स्थूल-पट m.n. coarse cloth.
स्थूल-पट्ट m. cotton.
स्थूल-पाद (I) a. having swelled legs.
स्थूल-पाद (II) m. 1. an elephant; 2. a man with elephantiasis.
स्थूल-मान n. gross or rough measure, rough computation.
स्थूल-मूल n. a kind of radish.
स्थूल-लक्ष, -लक्ष्य a. 1. munificent, liberal, generous; 2. wise, learned; 3. disposed to recollect both benefits and injuries.
स्थूल-लक्ष, -लक्ष्य a. 1. munificent, liberal, generous; 2. wise, learned; 3. disposed to recollect both benefits and injuries.
स्थूल-शंखा f. a woman having a large vulva.
स्थूल-शरीर n. the grosser or material and perishable body (as op. to सूक्ष्मशरिर).
स्थूल-शाटक, -शाटि m. thick or coarse cloth.
स्थूल-शाटक, -शाटि m. thick or coarse cloth.
स्थूल-शीर्षिका f. a small ant having a large head in proportion to its size.
स्थूल-षट्पद m. a wasp.
स्थूल-स्कंध m. the lakucha tree.
स्थूल-हस्त n. an elephant’s trunk.
स्थूलक (I) a. (f. का) Large, bulky.
स्थूलक (II) m. A sort of grass or reed.
स्थूलक (I) a. (f. का) Large, bulky.
स्थूलिन् m. A camel.
